headline: Palworld tower bosses: first four
title: How to Beat Palworld Tower Bosses Part 1 | Grizzbolt, Lyleen, Orserk, Faleris | Palworld Guide
video_script: Here's how to beat the first four Palworld tower bosses. Zoe and Grizzbolt: Grizzbolt is Electric, so bring Ground Pals. Lily and Lyleen: Lyleen is Grass, so bring Fire. Axel and Orserk: Orserk is Electric and Dragon, so both Ground and Ice Pals work. Marcus and Faleris: Faleris is Fire, so bring Water Pals like Jormuntide, Azurobe or Penking. Remember, tower fights now have a five minute timer, so hit hard! Which boss was hardest for you? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 tower bosses 1-4: Zoe & Grizzbolt (Electric, use Ground), Lily & Lyleen (Grass, use Fire), Axel & Orserk (Electric/Dragon, use Ground or Ice), Marcus & Faleris (Fire, use Water like Jormuntide, Azurobe, Penking). Tower fights have a 5-minute timer.
